candidates.title: Civil Designer
candidates.abstract: Experienced Civil Designer to produce detailed civil engineering designs using AutoCAD and Civil 3D.
candidates.content_text:
Why work with us:
At Shifted Designs, we strive to shift the way we think, operate, and design. We're a growing civil engineering consultancy focused on delivering practical, innovative and sustainable solutions across a diverse range of projects.
Our team values collaboration, initiative and continuous improvement. In return, we offer a supportive workplace, opportunities for professional growth, exposure to varied and rewarding projects, and a genuine chance to help shape the future of our business.
The Role:
We are seeking an experienced Civil Designer to produce detailed civil engineering designs and drawing packages using AutoCAD and Civil 3D. You will work closely with engineers and project managers on a range of residential, commercial and industrial developments, helping deliver high-quality design solutions from concept through to construction documentation.
Qualifications & Experience:
- Minimum 6 years' experience as a Civil Designer within an Australian engineering consultancy environment.
- Must be proficient in both AutoCAD and Civil 3D.          
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Demonstrated experience in the design and documentation of commercial and/or residential land development projects.
- Sound understanding of civil construction practices and industry standards.
- Experience in stormwater, earthworks, roads and subdivision design will be highly regarded.
- Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative team environment.
Key Responsibilities:
- Prepare detailed civil engineering designs and documentation for a range of residential, commercial and industrial development projects.
- Produce high-quality construction drawings, plans and supporting documentation.
- Use AutoCAD and Civil 3D to prepare detailed and precise civil drawings for earthworks, road, drainage and subdivision design.
- Develop and maintain Civil 3D models, surfaces, pipe networks and design data.
- Interpret and coordinate information from architectural, structural, electrical, hydraulic and other consultant drawings.
- Liaise closely with engineers and project managers to deliver practical and cost-effective design solutions.
- Ensure all drawings and documentation comply with company standards, relevant Australian Standards and client requirements.
- Manage multiple projects and deliver work within project budgets and deadlines.
Benefits:
- Convenient office location with easy access to public transport.
- Work alongside a close-knit team of friendly, experienced and motivated engineers
- Genuine opportunity to grow and progress with an expanding business.
- Develop your skills and challenge yourself while working on interesting and diverse projects.
- Ongoing professional development and opportunities to expand your technical skills.
- Supportive and collaborative workplace culture with direct access to senior engineers.
- Competitive remuneration package commensurate with experience and expertise.
- Visa Sponsorship: Nomination for temporary work visa and/or Permanent Residency will be considered for eligible candidates
candidates.teaser: Experienced Civil Designer to produce detailed civil engineering designs using AutoCAD and Civil 3D.

candidates.title: Civil Designer
candidates.abstract: Lead the design and delivery of civil infrastructure projects that shape Newcastle's future, from concept to construction.
bullets: Design the infrastructure that shapes Newcastle’s future
Hybrid working YOU design to ensure you’re there for the moments that matter
candidates.content_text:
At City of Newcastle (CN), you won't just design roads, drainage networks, cycleways and recreational infrastructure, you'll help create the places where our community lives, works and connects. This is an exciting opportunity to bring your technical expertise, creativity and project management skills to a role that delivers lasting outcomes for one of Australia's most vibrant and evolving cities.
As a member of our team, you won't just work for the city; you’ll co-create it. Here, your ideas and efforts directly shape the places where you and your community live, work, and play.
We currently have two permanent Civil Designer opportunities available within our team.
As a Civil Designer, you will take a lead role in the design and delivery of a diverse range of civil infrastructure projects. From initial investigations and concept development through to detailed design, approvals and construction support, you will be responsible for producing high-quality design documentation that transforms ideas into community assets.
Working collaboratively across the organisation and with external stakeholders, you will manage the design process, coordinate consultants and contractors, and oversee project budgets through the design and approval phases. You will provide technical advice during construction, work through complex design challenges and help ensure projects are delivered safely, sustainably and cost-effectively.
This role offers the opportunity to influence the future of Newcastle by delivering infrastructure that improves connectivity, enhances public spaces and supports a growing city. You'll apply your expertise to project investigations, design development, cost estimates, environmental assessments and planning approvals while ensuring compliance with relevant standards, legislation and best-practice design principles.
Beyond project delivery, you'll play an important role in strengthening capability across the team by sharing your knowledge, supporting less experienced designers and contributing to innovation and continuous improvement. You'll help foster a collaborative environment where safety, excellence and creative problem-solving are valued and encouraged.
We're looking for motivated and forward-thinking professionals who combine strong technical design skills with the ability to build relationships, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes. Through your work, you’ll have a behind the scenes pass to Newcastle's evolution as you shape our future as a liveable, inclusive city.
Life at City of Newcastle (CN) 
You’ll get to experience your work up close alongside the brilliant minds of your colleagues who care for one another and the region.
You’ll chip away at ambitious plans with a talented, passionate crew alongside you, shaping the very fabric of our community. Showing up for neighbours not shareholders.
Every single day offers the chance to think big and act local. Planning and prioritising to achieve the most important outcomes with the community.
You’ll add value in the moments that matter. From librarians to lifeguards, in a range of iconic places, we achieve a better Newcastle together.
Whether we’re planning to host major events, providing essential services or supporting creative artists, it’s what we do when the cameras aren't rolling that matters most.
And we’ll be there for you in important times in your life. We embrace flexible work arrangements to find a balance that allows us to enjoy the city we shape.
Our focus on inclusion and respecting culture, will help you feel a deeper connection with others. You'll connect with internal communities that will help you to feel a sense of belonging and reflect the diversity of the growing region.
You’ll do meaningful work and do it sustainably as you take ideas from plan to play, in your own backyard.
With hundreds of different roles, each person adds their uniqueness to our culture and plays their part as we head towards our 2040 vision.
With natural assets and a focus on the environment, co-create a sustainable region with us.
Why join CN? 
At CN, we value our employees, and their wellbeing takes priority. We encourage employees to make time for what's important and provide the benefits to enable a work life balance that allow us to enjoy the city we shape. To read more, visit here!
- 35-hour working week with flexible work arrangements.
- 4 weeks of annual leave, 3 weeks of personal leave, plus 2 additional paid public holidays
- 17.5% annual leave loading yearly payment
- Paid parental leave for primary carers
- Industry leading employment conditions
- Corporate Fitness program from as little as $18.00 per fortnight
- Access to a range of exclusive CN employee benefits programs including Novated Lease options as well as access to reward and recognition vouchers
- Annual performance development plans and ongoing training and development opportunities
- Leading the CN Way leadership program
- Inclusion, Diversity & Equity (IDE) employee networks and initiatives
- Access to Health & Wellbeing programs including an Onsite Physiotherapist and Psychology, Yoga and Mental Health Ambassador Groups
We champion inclusion so that everyone is valued, and we encourage innovation and creativity. We are committed to creating a safe and inclusive workplace where different styles, backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives are valued, encouraged, and respected.
People with diverse lived experiences (including but not limited to, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians, people with diverse gender identities and sexualities, people from different cultural, racial, ethnic, religious and linguistic backgrounds, people with disability, carers, and veterans) are encouraged to apply.
Don’t just work for the city, co-create it. Join and expand your career at the City of Newcastle.
Application Closing Date: Sunday 1 November 2026
Remuneration: $111,979.96 + 17.5% annual leave loading yearly payment + 12% Superannuation per annum for a 35-hour week
Contact: Clinton O’Meley – Senior Civil Designer – 02 4974 2747
If you need any adjustments to be made to the recruitment process or if you would like to discuss any accessibility requirements, please contact recruit@ncc.nsw.gov.au for a confidential discussion.
You must have the right to live and work in Australia to apply for this job.
CN do not accept unsolicited resumes, and we respectfully ask that recruitment agencies do not contact us at this stage.
candidates.teaser: Lead the design and delivery of civil infrastructure projects that shape Newcastle's future, from concept to construction.

candidates.title: Civil Engineer/Civil Drafter
candidates.abstract: Find meaningful rail projects in Queensland with a great team and flexible work options.
bullets: Unparalleled growth in QLD transit infrastructure
Are you a talented Engineer or Drafter in Rail Engineering?
candidates.content_text:
Queensland’s rail network is entering an exciting period of growth - and we’re working with highly regarded clients who have secured key projects that will help shape and strengthen the state’s rail infrastructure for decades to come.
We’re now looking to connect with experienced Civil Drafters, Civil Engineers and Designers who have genuine Queensland rail experience and want to be part of something with real longevity.
This is an opportunity to join an established, highly regarded organisation with an excellent culture, working alongside kind, collaborative and genuinely passionate engineering professionals. While some WFH flexibility is available, the focus is on continuing to grow a strong and connected Brisbane-based team, with the benefits of working together in the office.
We’re particularly interested in people with experience across:
 - Rail infrastructure and associated civil works
 - Queensland rail projects, standards and requirements
 - Civil drafting, design, and engineering
 - 12D software – strong capability is highly desirable
 - Working within multidisciplinary engineering environments
The work extends well beyond the immediate pipeline of major projects and events. You’ll have the opportunity to contribute to infrastructure that will support Queensland’s growing transport network for many years to come.
To be considered, you will need to have solid Australian experience, ideally within the Queensland rail sector, along with unrestricted Australian working rights. Unfortunately, visa sponsorship or candidates with restrictive work rights cannot be considered for these opportunities.
If you’re an experienced rail professional, confident in 12D and ready for your next challenge, I’d love to have a confidential conversation.
Please call Michelle Murphy on 0418 205 682 for a confidential discussion or apply now.
candidates.teaser: Find meaningful rail projects in Queensland with a great team and flexible work options.

candidates.title: Civil Designers/Civil Engineers - Multiple QLD opportunities!
candidates.abstract: Seeking passionate Civil Designers and Civil Engineers in Townsville to join a rapidly growing and supportive team.
bullets: Civil Design/Drafting and Civil Engineering opportunities
Work on an exciting pipeline of major projects
candidates.content_text:
We have opportunities for Civil Designers and talented Civil Engineers to work across a variety of projects in Townsville.
Bayside Group is partnering with our client, an established civil engineering and design consultancy with a strong presence in regional Queensland. They deliver practical, high-quality outcomes across infrastructure and land development work, with a genuine focus on supporting local communities.
This is a chance to join a team that values professionalism, safety, and doing the job properly. You will work alongside experienced designers, engineers and project leaders, working on incredible projects in Townsville, and nationally.
The Civil Designer will manage the civil design and drafting across a range of projects, producing high-quality plans, documentation and design deliverables. Detailed calculations and preparation of documentation for clients and authorities, working closely with Engineers, Project Managers, clients and other stakeholders. Prior relevant experience with 12D software, AutoCAD, and MS Office.
The Civil Engineer or Principal Civil Engineer will bring relevant and strong Australian experience from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 engineering consultancy. They will be a superior communicator with exposure to a variety of different projects.
We have Townsville-based vacancies, and as this is a rapidly growing and expanding business, we are open and encouraging of those to join and remain in Townsville, OR, join in Townsville and have opportunities to move to other locations and interstate. The current project list is vast and highly rewarding, and the pipeline of new projects is sensational.
Please note: Only applicants with work rights in Australia will be eligible.
To submit your application in strict confidence, click the 'apply' button. If you require further information, please contact Michelle Murphy on 0418 205 682 for a confidential chat.
candidates.teaser: Seeking passionate Civil Designers and Civil Engineers in Townsville to join a rapidly growing and supportive team.

candidates.title: Civil Designer
candidates.abstract: Join Ausenco in Newcastle as a Civil Designer, delivering innovative civil design solutions across exciting mining projects.
bullets: Grow your career with mentoring, training and supportive leadership
Enjoy flexible working arrangements and a great work-life balance
Work on exciting mining projects with a global consultancy
candidates.content_text:
Ausenco is a fast-growing company with big ideas. We redefine what’s possible in some of the world’s most complex projects and toughest environments. Delivering innovative, value-add consulting, project delivery, asset operations and maintenance solutions is what we do. From 21 offices in 9 countries, with projects in over 80 locations worldwide, we create sustainable outcomes for our people, clients and communities.
As a result of a growing pipeline of awarded work, are currently recruiting for a Civil Designer to join our Newcastle team. 
About the Role
- Develop earthworks, drainage, and roadway design solutions that meet client specifications and project requirements.
- Ensure all design outputs and documentation are accurate, complete, and aligned with project standards.
- Uphold consistent drafting practices by adhering to Ausenco’s design and documentation standards across all projects.
- Provide technical expertise and support to team members within the discipline.
- Mentor and assist graduate engineers and designers to foster their professional growth. 
About You
- Minimum of 5 years’ experience in earthworks, roadworks, and drainage design within industries such as mining, mineral processing, materials handling, or heavy industrial.
- Advanced Diploma in Engineering or equivalent qualification is desirable.
- Proven expertise in Civil 3D and AutoCAD is essential. 12D experience with a willingness to upskill in Civil 3D my be considered for the right candidate,
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Self-motivated with excellent time management and the ability to work independently.
Why Ausenco?
We support individual growth and aim to allow you to work in a way that plays to your strengths. In addition to a competitive remuneration package, we offer:
- Career advancement - Be supported in your ongoing development with technical training, mentoring programs and frequent networking opportunities.
- Work Life Balance – Be empowered to enjoy your life outside of the office with flexible working hours, work from home arrangements and modern leave policies including paid parental leave and floating public holiday programs.
- Holistic approach to wellness – Take a proactive approach to your overall wellbeing. Access confidential services as a courtesy of Ausenco including online health and fitness programs, financial coaching, and confidential counselling services.
- Accessible leadership team – Work with highly reputable market leaders who value your contribution.
Our people don’t settle for the status quo. If you have an entrepreneurial spirit and want to help set a new standard in sustainability, we’ll help you find your place. This means working with you to develop a unique career path and skillset to match your ambition.
We’re proud of the work we do, and we do it within a culture that is open, honest, and cooperative. We have a history of attracting visionary people who embrace challenges and deliver creative solutions for every project, and your voice is an important part of the conversation.
As a global company we embrace and encourage diversity in its fullest sense – gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, experience, nationality, colour, language, religion, location, disability, education, skills, working styles and time availability. Our work environments are based on mutual trust and respect for the rights and opportunities of every individual.
Join us and work a better way.
candidates.teaser: Join Ausenco in Newcastle as a Civil Designer, delivering innovative civil design solutions across exciting mining projects.

candidates.title: Graduate Engineer, Piling
candidates.abstract: Civil Engineering degree or similar, with a geotechnical focus (Must have graduate by January 2027)
bullets: Must have Graduated in Engineering related field by January 2027
Opportunities across regional projects | Project Allowances and Living Allowance
candidates.content_text:
ACCIONA is a global company, leading in the development of regenerative infrastructure that creates a positive impact on society. Our workforce consists of more than 65,000 professionals, present in more than 40 countries across the five continents, all contributing to our mission to design a better planet. Are you a passionate individual who wants to make a difference, promote sustainable development, and find solutions to the biggest global challenges, including climate change, overpopulation, and water scarcity? Come and join us in building the infrastructure our planet needs to achieve a sustainable future.
Geotech, one of Acciona' s specialist businesses with over fifty years of experience at the frontlines of design and delivery. The range of expertise includes foundation piling, basement construction, ground improvement, ground anchors, water infrastructure construction and more.
As one of Australia's largest and most diversely skilled engineering and construction contracting business, Geotech has the capabilities to be a single contractor to a broad spectrum of clients, delivering the full scope of works.
About Opportunity
We are looking for a Graduate Engineer to join our Geotech business, this role requires you to have total flexibility and able to support projects across Australia in regional locations.
When on site you will receive Living Away From Home allowances and project allowances. 
You will deliver the full range of a ground and foundation engineer's responsibilities across piling, ground anchoring and ground improvement works, from safety and construction documentation through to procurement, budget tracking, services and utilities investigation, and specialist testing.
Key accountabilities
- Identify the whole-of-life aspects of infrastructure being delivered
- Identify project specifications and draft inspection and test plans (ITPs) to ensure verification of compliance with the contract
- Administer bored pile, CFA, driven, sheet piling and ground improvement works to safety, environmental and quality requirements
- Administer ground anchoring, soil nails, slope stabilisation and grout curtain works to safety, environmental and quality requirements
- Develop and implement construction procedures for piling, ground anchors, soil nailing and ground improvement
- Investigate services and utilities and issue internal permits to work
- Prepare Work Procedures, ITPs, SWMS and Site Access Plans for specialist ground works
- Coordinate pile integrity testing, static and dynamic load testing, and anchor proof and lock off testing
- Prepare, track and forecast construction budgets, and manage daily cost control
- Record daily progress, deliveries, resourcing, delays, variations and day works accurately
Qualification and Competencies 
- Civil Engineering degree or similar, with a geotechnical focus (Must have graduate by January 2027)
- Ideally exposure in foundation construction activities for transmission line and major infrastructure projects, including piling, stub setting, excavation, reinforcement installation, concreting, and associated ground engineering works highly desirable
- Current driver licence and access to a reliable vehicle
- Ability to achieve a successful Pre-Employment Medical and National Crime Check is required.
candidates.teaser: Civil Engineering degree or similar, with a geotechnical focus (Must have graduate by January 2027)
